blocks.rationale: Jointly make the Representatives exception source-sensitive and revise its consequence. The recipient classes and safeguards are read from each current NDA. The terminal rule distinguishes an express third-party query from an employee query: a general third-party prohibition contradicts the former, while the latter is entailed only by a computed employee exception and otherwise remains unmentioned unless the contract expressly supplies the relevant exception structure. This fixes both trigger disclosure views while preserving the historical inline and Paragraph 4 exception patterns.
